verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Misconception that positive expansion work increases internal energy in adiabatic processes verified. First Law of Thermodynamics Delta U = Q - W_by = Q + W_on. In an adiabatic process, Q = 0, so Delta U = -W_by. Expansion implies W_by > 0, which directly forces Delta U < 0. For an ideal gas, Delta U = n*C_V*Delta T < 0, guaranteeing temperature drop (cooling). Physical refutation, sign convention clarification, and corrective pedagogical exposition verified.
